items.summary: Exposes a $12B modeling mistake in PJM's grid design that wasted ratepayer money and argues for a fundamental overhaul of American grid design, highlighting the role of cold air in improving efficiency.

items.title_en: AI;DR Essay Criticizes AI-Generated Tech Content
items.summary: An essay criticizing the prevalence of AI-generated content in technical communication, arguing that it undermines genuine human exchange and readability, with community comments sharing similar experiences in code reviews and online reading.

items.summary: Wiz's red team demonstrates that an AI-generated GitHub Copilot autofix introduced a CI/CD vulnerability used to compromise Snowflake's Jira, illustrating the security risks of AI-assisted code changes.
